parsedVerdict.reasoning: The three files together describe the data shape of the Order aggregate: the order root, its line items and its shipping address. order.interface.ts builds IOrder and IOrderEditable from IOrderItem and IShippingAddress/IShippingAddressEditable, so the module's own abstractions are reused rather than redefined. The 'Editable' split is applied the same way in both places: IShippingAddress extends IShippingAddressEditable and only adds id, and IOrderEditable reuses IShippingAddressEditable. No unrelated concern is mixed in, and no rule or invariant is duplicated, because these are plain shape contracts with no logic. One minor overlap: IOrder declares both shippingAddressId and shippingAddress (which carries its own id), so the same identity is held in two places. This is a common persistence-shaped pattern and does not split the module's concern, so it is not reported as a violation.
